scope: Independent read-only review of movement.patch on base 067b3cb7cad5148c09f309fd4f5b4750dc2d8515
status: Changes requested; original frozen patch invalidated by author pending fixes and regression tests

findings.trigger: Cross a screen boundary while zoomed away from the default arm length.
findings.issue: SelectScreen/RestoreCamera assign an unzoomed preset before interpolation, causing a visible camera snap on the transition frame.
findings.requested_fix: Honor the desired zoom during screen selection/restoration; test the first transition frame across outdoor screens.

findings.trigger: Apply sp_size to a script humanoid after its secondary body rotation becomes nonzero.
findings.issue: ApplyScriptCharacter replaces the relative transform before Configure resets BodyDynamics; retained AppliedBodyRotation then subtracts stale lean from the new authored transform, permanently biasing the base pose.
findings.requested_fix: Reset applied rotation bookkeeping with replacement presentation; test reconfiguration after nonzero lean and verify the authored base rotation.

validation: Code-path inspection only; git diff --check passed. Reviewer did not build or run games.
publication: Do not publish the v1 patch as approved or cite interrupted full-suite runs as passing.
